name: 7 Wonders Duel

setup.text: Place the board between the players and the Conflict pawn on the neutral middle space.
Put the 4 Military tokens face up on their spaces.
Shuffle the Progress tokens and place 5 face up on the board. Return the rest to the box.
Set one deck per Age. Return 3 cards of each Age to the box unseen, then add 3 random Guild cards to Age III.
Shuffle the 12 Wonders and lay 4 face up. First player takes 1, second takes 2, first takes the last.
Lay 4 more. This time the second player picks first, with the same 1-2-1 order. Each player now has 4 Wonders.

turn.summary: Take an accessible card from the structure and play it one of three ways, then reveal any newly uncovered cards.
steps: Set up each Age's structure of 20 cards, some face up and some down, following the layout on the last page.
An accessible card is one not partly covered by another.
Construct the Building: pay its cost and add it to your city.
Or discard it for 2 coins plus 1 per yellow card you own.
Or construct a Wonder: pay its cost, then tuck the card facedown under it.
Missing resources are bought from the bank for 2 plus the opponent's matching brown and grey symbols.
Chain symbols let you build a later card free.
After playing, flip newly uncovered cards. Some Wonders give another turn.

round_end: An Age ends when all 20 cards are played.
The player with the weaker military chooses who starts the next Age; if the pawn is central, the last active player chooses.
Only 7 Wonders get built. When the 7th is built, return the unbuilt one to the box.
end: The game ends at once if a player wins by military or scientific supremacy. Otherwise it ends after Age III and the most victory points wins.

scoring.text: Military points depend on where the Conflict pawn is: 0, 2, 5 or 10.
Add points from your Buildings (blue, green, yellow, purple), your Wonders and your Progress tokens.
Each complete set of 3 coins in your treasury scores 1 point.

tiebreak: Most points from blue Civilian buildings; if still tied, share the win.

missed.text: Resources are not spent; they can be used each turn, all game.
Resources from yellow cards and Wonders do not affect trading prices.
Military supremacy: the pawn entering your opponent's capital wins immediately.
Scientific supremacy: 6 different science symbols win immediately.
A matching pair of science symbols lets you take a Progress token.
A replay effect that would fall at the end of an Age, when the structure is empty, is lost.

unverified: Which pawn zone gives 2, 5 or 10 points is shown on the board, not in the text.
Military token effects other than the 2 and 5 coin looting are shown as icons.
The card layout for each Age is a picture.
